title: Artisan Story & Heritage Generator
promptTemplate: Generate an evocative 100-word heritage story in {language} for an artisan craft named "{craftName}" from {cityName}, {stateName}. Highlight its origin, traditional materials ({materials}), cultural significance, and artisan legacy.

title: Fair Trade Smart Pricing Calculator
promptTemplate: Analyze labor hours ({hours}), material costs ({materialCost}), rarity score ({rarityScore}), GI certification status, and craft category "{category}" to calculate fair artisan payout and recommended retail price band in {language}.

title: Voice-to-Listing Product Assistant
promptTemplate: Transcribe rural artisan voice description in {language} for craft item "{craftName}". Automatically structure into title, material specs, price band, care instructions, and search tags.

title: Vernacular Heritage Translator
promptTemplate: Translate craft description "{sourceText}" into {targetLanguage} preserving cultural nuances, technical artisan terminology, and emotional storytelling appeal.

title: Craft Studio Image Enhancer
promptTemplate: Analyze craft photograph of "{craftName}" and generate AI enhancement prompt for studio lighting, background neutral isolation, motif highlighting, and authenticity tag placement.
